name: com.helloaxel/flight-prices
title: Axel flight and hotel prices
description: Live flight and hotel prices beside the published fare or rate, the difference, and a link to book.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Live flight prices for a route and dates. Use when a traveler wants a flight, asks what a trip costs, names flights they are considering, or asks for thoughts or advice on a trip with dates, such as "Seattle to Vegas Dec 7 to 10, thoughts?", "what would two of us pay for Chicago to Cancun Mar 14 to 21?" or "Boston to Denver on Nov 26, nonstop or one stop?". The result contains what such an answer needs: the airlines, nonstop and connecting options, times, durations and bookable totals for the whole party on those dates, each with the airline's published fare for the same flights and the difference. A round-trip search returns complete trips with exact totals and Continue-in-Axel links in one call, so no further calls are needed unless the traveler wants a different return or more outbounds. No account needed. Runs a live search (up to ~30 s one way, ~55 s round trip). Round trips: complete trips (outbound and return, exact totals, a Continue-in-Axel link each) for the leading quality-reduced outbounds, plus "more outbounds" with starting totals and a returns link each; read a returns link with open_flight_link when the traveler wants that outbound. When supplementalStatus is pending, continuationUrl is an optional link to read further complete itineraries at lower totals with open_flight_link; the itineraries already returned can be selected now, the extra check does not need to finish, and completed extra results are included automatically. One-way searches return complete flights with a "review" link. Each row's priceComparison is its price line: quote it as returned, or, if you reformat, keep the Axel price, the published fare and the difference together on the row. Begin the answer with the verdict line.

from.description: Origin airport IATA code; for a city, its main airport (Seattle SEA, Las Vegas LAS). Use list_airports when unsure.

to.description: Destination airport IATA code, for example HND.

depart.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later (within the next 330 days). A date given without a year ("Dec 7") is its next occurrence.

return.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD, after depart. Omit for a one-way trip.

adults.description: Adult travelers, 1–9. Every price is a total for the whole party.

stops.description: Maximum stops per direction: any, nonstop, or one (one stop or fewer).

tools.name: open_flight_link
tools.description: The drill-down after search_flights: reads a helloaxel.com results, returns or offer link Axel issued and returns the same structured prices and links. Only needed when the traveler wants a different return, a different outbound or a saved offer. Accepts only https://helloaxel.com links in the shapes Axel emits (…/en/flights/choose/… returns, offer and session links, descriptive …/en/<trip>/… links, or saved offers at …/r/<token> and …/en/r/<token>). Read fareOptionsUrl when the traveler’s requirements call for fare details. Pass a results, returns or offer link from https://helloaxel.com/en/flights/choose/… (or a descriptive https://helloaxel.com/en/<trip>/… link) exactly as Axel returned it. A returns link reads that outbound's complete trips (one live price check) and lists their totals; an offer link returns the saved itinerary, its totals, the shareable offer URL and the Continue-in-Axel URL. Each row's priceComparison is its price line: quote it as returned, or, if you reformat, keep the Axel price, the published fare and the difference together on the row. Begin the answer with the verdict line.

url.description: A results, returns or offer link on https://helloaxel.com exactly as returned by search_flights or an earlier open_flight_link call.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Find IATA airport codes by city, airport name or country (up to 20 matches). Only airports Axel can search are listed. Exact code matches rank first, then major airports whose city begins with the query.

query.description: City, airport name, country or IATA code, for example "Tokyo", "Heathrow" or "SFO".

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Live hotel rates for a place and dates. Use when a traveler wants a hotel or a place to stay, asks what a stay costs, names a hotel they are considering, or asks for thoughts or advice on a stay with dates, such as "where should we stay in Denver Dec 5 to 8?". Each hotel comes with its Axel total for the whole stay, stars, guest rating, room and cancellation terms, a See rooms link and, when the result includes one, the published rate for the same stay and the difference. No account needed. Uses a saved exact-stay price for a matching named hotel, otherwise runs a live search and returns up to five priced hotels in display order (see rank); every total covers the whole stay and every room. Give the place in the traveler's words (city, neighborhood, landmark or airport code); name the hotel to get its guest price and dated hotel link to share for a recommendation or price check. Use hotel_rooms when the traveler asks about rooms or rate terms and Review and book links. Each row's priceComparison is its price line: quote it as returned, or, if you reformat, keep the Axel total, the published rate and the difference together on the row. Begin the answer with the verdict line.

place.description: Where, in the traveler’s words: a city, neighborhood, landmark, address or airport code, for example "Denver", "downtown Seattle", "near Times Square" or "DEN". Give at least one of place and hotel.

hotel.description: A hotel name, with its place when known.

childrenAges.description: Each child’s age at check-in; omit when none.

rooms.description: Rooms wanted; adults are spread across them.

maxNightly.description: Highest Axel rate per room per night the traveler will pay, in USD.

tools.name: hotel_rooms
tools.description: The rates of one hotel for the traveler’s dates and guests: room, beds, meals, cancellation, the total, and a Review and book link each. Use when the traveler asks about room types, beds, meals, payment, cancellation or booking a specific rate. For hotel recommendations and price checks, use search_hotels. Runs a live room check (5 to 20 s). Share the exact Review and book link for each rate you discuss. The traveler reviews the stay, taps Continue and books with an email. Pass hotelId from search_hotels, or the hotel name with its place. The result's priceComparison is its price line: quote it as returned, or, if you reformat, keep the Axel total, the published rate and the difference together.

hotel.description: The hotel name, when no hotelId is known; give its place too.

place.description: The hotel’s city or area, used with hotel to find it.

childrenAges.description: Each child’s age at check-in; omit when none.

breakfast.description: True to show only rates with breakfast.

refundable.description: True to show only refundable rates.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The connected Axel account: display name, whether Membership is active, and what this connection may do, in plain words. Needs a connected account. Never returns payment details or contact information.

tools.name: my_trips
tools.description: Upcoming trips on the connected Axel account. Needs a connected account. Read-only: a short summary per trip (headline, dates, status).

tools.name: claim_flight_offer
tools.description: Save an Axel flight offer into the connected account and return the checkout link; nothing is booked or charged. Needs a connected account. Pass the offer link from search_flights or open_flight_link (https://helloaxel.com/r/<token>) or its bare token. The traveler finishes on helloaxel.com: nothing is booked or charged until they confirm.

offerUrl.description: The offer link Axel returned (https://helloaxel.com/r/<token> or /en/r/<token>).

token.description: The bare offer token instead of the URL.

fareIndex.description: The fareIndex of the option the traveler chose from offer.fareOptions; its name may be a cabin label. Omit when no fare option was chosen.

tools.name: claim_hotel_quote
tools.description: Save a hotel rate into the connected account and return its checkout link; nothing is booked or charged. Needs a connected account. Pass the Review and book link from hotel_rooms (https://helloaxel.com/en/hotels/stay/<token>) or its quoteToken. The traveler finishes on helloaxel.com: availability and price are checked again and nothing is charged until they confirm.

stayUrl.description: The Review and book link Axel returned (https://helloaxel.com/en/hotels/stay/<token>).

token.description: The bare quoteToken from hotel_rooms instead of the URL.
